facts.statement: Sirindhorna is a hadrosauroid ornithopod dinosaur found in Early Cretaceous deposits in northeastern Thailand.
facts.quote: Sirindhorna is a genus of hadrosauroid ornithopod dinosaur from Early Cretaceous deposits of northeastern Thailand.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna was described in 2015 by Japanese, Thai, and Chinese paleontologists Masateru Shibata, Pratueng Jintasakul, Yoichi Azuma, and Hai-Lu You.
facts.quote: Described in 2015 by Japanese, Thai, and Chinese palaeontologists Masateru Shibata, Pratueng Jintasakul, Yoichi Azuma and Hai-Lu You

facts.statement: The genus name Sirindhorna honors Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn for her support of paleontology in Thailand.
facts.quote: The generic name is dedication to Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn for her contribution to the support and encouragement of palaeontology in Thailand.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna khoratensis is the type and only known species of the genus Sirindhorna.
facts.quote: The type and only species of the genus is Sirindhorna khoratensis.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna is the first ornithopod from Southeast Asia known from a well-preserved skull, making it the third iguanodont species found in Thailand.
facts.quote: It's the third species of iguanodont found in Thailand, following Siamodon and Ratchasimasaurus, both known from poorer material, and the first ornithopod from Southeast Asia to have a well-preserved skull.

facts.statement: Fossils of Sirindhorna were discovered when farmers digging to create a reservoir found dinosaur remains.
facts.quote: Digging to make a reservoir, farmers happened upon dinosaur fossils.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna lived during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 112 million years ago.
facts.quote: it's thought to mostly likely date the Aptian stage of the late Early Cretaceous Period, between 125 and 112 million years ago.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna lived in Asia during the Early Cretaceous, specifically the Aptian stage, between 125 and 112 million years ago.
facts.quote: que vivó a mediados del período Cretácico, entre 125 y 112 millones de años, durante el Aptiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Sirindhorna is classified within the infraorder Ornithopoda.
Sirindhorna belongs to the unranked family Hadrosauroidea.
The parent group of Sirindhorna is Hadrosauroidea.
Fossil records place Sirindhorna in the Aptian stage, ranging from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The genus is known from the holotype specimen NRRU3001-166, an articulated braincase, and several disarticulated referred specimens.
rejected.quote: The taxon is known from the holotype specimen NRRU3001-166, an articulated braincase, as well as a number of disarticulated referred specimens.
